name: AP2
summary: Agent Payments Protocol, started by Google and donated to the FIDO Alliance in April 2026. Users authorize purchases through signed, verifiable mandates (checkout and payment) that merchants, networks and issuers can check, for both human-present and human-not-present purchases.
facts: Signed checkout and payment mandates as verifiable credentials
A2A and UCP; samples include x402
goodFor: Auditable proof that a user authorized a purchase
watchOut: Early (v0.2); standardization still in FIDO working groups
Needs merchants, issuers and networks to adopt it
